title: ExyliaAnnouncer
description: Simple announcer with center messages an MiniMessages Support
body:
# **ExyliaAnnouncer**
#### Rotating announcements for Velocity

---

## **Features**
- Automatic rotating announcements  
- Full MiniMessage support  
- Centered messages  
- Configurable sounds  
- Per-announcement permissions  
- Player toggle  

## **Commands**
- `/announcer reload` — Reload configuration  
- `/announcer force <id>` — Force an announcement  
- `/announcer preview <id>` — Personal preview  
- `/announcer list` — List announcements  
- `/announcer toggle` — Enable/disable announcements  

## **Permissions**
- `announcer.admin` — Admin commands  
- `announcer.toggle` — Toggle command  

## **Requirements**
- Velocity 3.4.0+  
- Java 21+
